strategyReview: The proven YES-overpricing edge is working: one-touch NO premium fade is 4/4 live with high average P&L, manual IV-touch rich-NO shadows are 9/10, and the top panel NO cuts show strong holdout returns. The weekend HL funding reversion live book remains the volume winner (69% win, +$1.10 on 612 trades) even though per-trade edge is small. The failures are concentrated in fragile shadow clones: single-name weekend funding thresholds, HYPE-confirmed BTC momentum, spot-decline formulations of one-touch contract trades, and shallow PM-IV compression entries.

failureClusters.evidence: CBRS is 15/33 (45%), MU 8/21 (38%), AAPL 13/26 (50%). These fire on any day with funding < -10%, and outcomes show funding staying negative or falling further instead of normalizing.
failureClusters.recommendation: Stop testing the any-day -10% trigger. Refine to true-weekend relative extremes with confirmation of normalization, or let the cleanup kill the family.

failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 9/25 (36%). BTC longs with HYPE risk-on confirmations repeatedly produce sub-2% or negative moves, matching late-FOMO behavior.
failureClusters.recommendation: Do not promote HYPE-confirmed BTC continuation. Kill that variant or replace the confirmation with a contrary condition, but do not spend more tests on the current mechanism.

failureClusters.evidence: Gold one-touch heatmap is 8/23 (35%) and 7 tests unscorable. Examples show NO contracts barely move or win on terminal settlement while the thesis predicts a >2% spot decline.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author all one-touch rich-NO trades as contract premium fades with direction=neutral, and stop writing spot-decline predictions for contract trades.

failureClusters.evidence: btc_iv_compression_vol_reversion is 5/18 (28%). Most losses ended below the 2% absolute move threshold; cheap PM IV can persist without any spot expansion.
failureClusters.recommendation: Require stronger compression and a turn in PM IV before entry, or kill the spot-absolute-move formulation.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: replace the any-day -10% CBRS funding trigger with a true-weekend relative extreme. This avoids noisy weekday readings and only fires when CBRS funding is in the tail of its own recent range.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS perp rises >2% within 2 days as extreme weekend funding normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-537: shift AAPL funding reversion to true weekends and require a relative 30-day tail reading rather than any day below -10%.
newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL perp rises >2% within 2 days as extreme weekend funding normalizes.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-534: re-author the gold one-touch cap-edge signal as a contract premium fade instead of a spot-decline call. Use a moderate 3-8pt edge on near-dated liquid above-strike contracts.
newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES / holding NO on these GOLD above-strike one-touch contracts is profitable over 5 days as the rich premium decays, without requiring a >2% spot decline.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-638: require PM IV to be both deeply compressed and already turning higher before betting on a vol snapback. This avoids entries where cheap IV stays cheap.
newHypotheses.prediction: BTC spot makes a >2% absolute move within 3 days as compressed PM IV begins to normalize.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-535: restrict MU funding reversion to weekends and replace the absolute -10% trigger with a relative 30-day tail reading.
newHypotheses.prediction: MU perp rises >2% within 2 days as extreme weekend funding normalizes.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The single -10% CBRS funding trigger is not extreme enough; outcomes show funding repeatedly falling further or staying pinned instead of normalizing. The >2% spot move does not follow reliably.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes within 2 days and forces a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL variant barely beats coin flip, and many triggers occur when funding is already mild. Losses cluster when funding stays flat or falls.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day reliably normalizes and forces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The HYPE cross-asset confirmation is failing as a timing signal. BTC longs near local highs with HYPE risk-on produce many small or negative moves, matching late-FOMO rather than durable continuation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI independently confirms durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO/overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The gold one-touch variant is being graded on contract prices while the thesis predicts a >2% spot decline. Examples show NO contracts barely moving or winning on terminal settlement, so the spot-decline formulation is wrong.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large gold underlying-cap edge on upside one-touch NO contracts predicts a >2% GOLD spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The MU -10% funding trigger is weak; funding can go further negative or fade without the expected spot move. Only the deepest relative extremes normalize reliably.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and produces >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Compression-only entries fail because cheap PM IV can persist; several losses ended with sub-2% moves. The z-score < -1.5 condition is too shallow and lacks confirmation of a turning point.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC PM IV below its 30-day mean by more than 1.5 standard deviations reliably leads to a >2% absolute spot move within 3 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: OIL one-touch NO premium fade is working as a contract-grade family: 60% win over 42 tests. Keep descendants predicting contract premium decay, not spot moves.
BTC near-dated moderate 3-8pt NO fade is performing well early. It should stay contract-graded and pool with FIND-0043 siblings.

journalEntry: Tonight was mostly cleanup: several single-name weekend funding shadow clones are weak and need relative-weekend refinements, not more threshold tests. The strongest edge remains YES-overpricing. I authored four executable panel NO siblings with distinct liquidity/spread/direction cuts, plus refinements for the struggling funding, one-touch, and IV-compression families. No parameter updates: weekend-clustered shadow evidence is suggestive but not strong enough to move the funding entry band, and signal risk changes are not yet supported by clean clusters.
